components.navigation: Top bar and side rail architecture. Clean lines, 1px border. Fixed layout with content scrolling independently.
components.kpi_cards: Flat design with 1px border. Prominent value (text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight). Top-left metric focus. Color-coded left-border (4px) or badge for status (Red, Amber, Green).
components.tabs: Shadcn UI tabs. Overridden styling to be clean, border-bottom focused instead of pills. Active state: border-slate-900 text-slate-900.
components.buttons: Square or very slightly rounded (rounded-sm). Primary: bg-slate-900 text-white hover:bg-slate-800. Secondary: border border-slate-200 bg-white text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-50.
components.tables: Dense layout. Header font-semibold uppercase text-xs tracking-wider. Row hover: hover:bg-slate-50. Clickable items (plaques, pièces jointes) should use font-medium text-slate-900 underline decoration-slate-300 hover:decoration-slate-900 transition-colors.
components.drawer_detail_view: Can be a max-w-4xl right-side drawer or full page. Must contain vehicle header (photo, plaque, VIN, tags) and below, a tabbed interface for Leasing, Assurance, etc.
components.progress_bars: For leasing usage (months/km). Thin (h-2). Track: bg-slate-100. Fill: dynamic color based on % used (green -> amber -> red).
components.drag_drop_zone: Dashed 2px border (border-slate-300 hover:border-slate-500). bg-slate-50 hover:bg-slate-100 transition-colors. Center icon (lucide-react UploadCloud).
components.timeline: Vertical left-bordered steps for history. Horizontal gantt or calendar view for dashboard deadlines.

interactive_states.hover: Subtle shifts. Borders darken (border-slate-300 to border-slate-400), backgrounds slightly dim (bg-white to bg-slate-50).
interactive_states.motion: Fast, functional transitions. transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out.

media.icons_library: lucide-react (functional, clean line icons). Need to import UploadCloud, Car, FileText, AlertTriangle, CheckCircle, Clock, Calendar, Image, MoreVertical.

vehicle_placeholder.description: Clean white semi-truck to be used as default vehicle photo in header.

damage_inspection_1.description: Car with dented bumper for etat des lieux examples.

damage_inspection_2.description: Car on tow truck for accident/damage reporting.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text against colored badges passes WCAG AA. Red/Amber/Green text on light backgrounds.
accessibility.aria_labels: Required on all icon buttons and drag-drop zones.
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY on all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='vehicle-plate-link', data-testid='kpi-expired-card', data-testid='tab-leasing').

pages_to_build.name: Dashboard Administratif
pages_to_build.description: Main overview page. High-level KPIs (expired leases, upcoming inspections) using the 3-color status system. Timeline visualization for deadlines. Fleet health summary.

pages_to_build.name: Fiche Véhicule Administrative
pages_to_build.description: Detailed view (Drawer or Page). Header with vehicle details + photo. Tabs: Leasing, Assurance, Carte Grise, État des lieux, Contrôles techniques, Documents. All interactions open this context.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure standard HTML input/selects are NOT used; rely on customized Shadcn components.
Implement the Layout with a Side Navbar and a Top Header.
Use data-testid on all interactive buttons, links, tabs, and form elements.
KPI values must be large (text-4xl) and use the primary tracking-tight font.
Empty states for folders/documents should show a minimalist grayed-out icon and an actionable 'Upload' prompt.
Alerts (180/90/30 days) should map to colors: >90 days = Green (conforme), <90 days = Amber (bientôt expiré), <30 days or expired = Red (expiré).
All pricing/currency formatted as CHF (Swiss Francs). Language: French.
Ensure 'Cabinet Grotesk' is applied to Headings and 'Satoshi' to body by updating tailwind.config.js and index.css.
The UI should look extremely premium, mimicking SaaS leaders like Motive, Fleetio, and Samsara (dense, flat, high-contrast, data-heavy but clean).
